Home.eyebrow: Tax, legal, corporate, IP, and compliance
Home.title: One portal for the professional work.
Home.sub: Discover a service, open an account, send documents, and follow the case. A person reviews regulated advice. You only see your own record.
Home.howSub: From the first inquiry to a completed case, with the fee and the government charge written apart.
Home.accountBody: Tax, corporate, legal, IP, or compliance. The catalogue says what the work needs.
Home.incomeBody: One account holds the client, the requests, the documents, and the payments.
Home.reviewBody: Upload what the case asks for. A person checks it before regulated work goes out.
Home.filedBody: Status, the assigned person, and the receipt stay on the same record.
Home.whySub: One client record. Service fees stay separate from government charges. AI can guide intake. It does not replace a qualified review.
Home.fbrCardBody: Returns, NTN, sales tax, and the salary calculator. The result is an estimate until a person reviews it.
Home.expertsBody: Company formation, SECP work, and the documents those cases need.
Home.secureBody: Matters stay on the assigned file. Clients see their own cases, not anyone else's.
Home.supportBody: Trademarks and related applications, with deadlines and status on the case.
Home.fastBody: Recurring filings and the checklist of what is still missing.
Home.refundsCardBody: The request, documents, quotation, payment, and final outcome stay together.
Home.pricingSub: Sample packages only. A quotation is separate, and government charges are not inside the service fee.
Home.calcSub: This is the salary calculator. It uses the Tax Year 2027 salaried ruleset. It does not file a return.
Home.calcChart: Share of annual salary that is tax
Home.appTitle: The same portal on a phone
Home.app1: See case status, documents, and payments on the phone site.
Home.app2: Upload a document from the camera roll.
Home.app3: A store app can come later. The website is the working portal.
Home.aQuote: Sample review. I could see which service I needed before anyone was assigned. The government charge was written apart from the fee.
Home.bQuote: Sample review. The case showed the missing document, then the status after it was checked. I only saw my own file.
Home.cQuote: Sample review. I used the salary calculator, then asked a person to review the matter. Nothing on this card is a real customer quote.
Home.fileA: Tax, corporate, legal, intellectual property, and compliance work. A client sees only their own services, documents, and payments.
Home.ntnA: The request becomes a case: documents, a quotation, payment, an assigned person, review, then completion. Each step stays on that case.
Home.feeA: No. The service fee and the government charge are quoted apart.
Home.estimateQ: Can the calculator or assistant decide the matter?
Home.estimateA: No. The salary calculator is an estimate from the published Tax Year 2027 slabs. A qualified person reviews regulated tax or legal work.
Home.deadlineNote: The date is 30 September 2027 in this preview. Confirm the live FBR deadline before you rely on the count.
